name: services/crstests/duplicate_subtree
description:
Duplicates a subtree of the test. The duplicated subtree has the same parent as the base subtree. The order of the root of the new subtree is highest possible i.e. it is added as the last child to the parent.
Please note:
  • This methods can't duplicate whole trees i.e. You can't pass id of some root as 'node_id' parameter
  • Only structure, properties, and permissions are duplicated, grades and points are not duplicated

arguments.name: node_id
arguments.description: ID of the node which is the root of the subtree we want to duplicate.

arguments.name: name_pl
arguments.description: Name of the root of the duplicated subtree (in polish).

arguments.name: name_en
arguments.description: Name of the root of the duplicated subtree (in english).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
Dictionary with only one key 'id'.
	ID of the newly created root of the duplicated subtree (not the root of the whole tree).
